evals.name: hero-two-columns
evals.prompt: Build a hero: heading and text on the left, an image on the right, two columns on desktop and stacked on mobile.
evals.expected_output: A Section with Row + Col span={6} (or ContentWrapper variant="columns"), Heading/Paragraph/ButtonWrapper/Img components, no custom CSS, no px, checked at 390 and 1440.
assertions: Uses Section and Row/Col or ContentWrapper — no hand-written flex or grid CSS for the columns
Text uses Heading, Paragraph and ButtonWrapper components, with Heading tag chosen for the outline
No px values, hex colors or clamp() in the new markup or CSS
No @media query other than the breakpoint values 30rem, 48rem or 62rem

evals.name: more-space-above
evals.prompt: There's not enough space above the testimonials block on the about page — add more.
evals.expected_output: A <Spacer size> (or the Section's gap) from the spacing scale at that spot; no margin hack fighting the container's zeroed margins, no new px value.
assertions: The extra space is a Spacer with a token size, a Section gap change, or a margin-top-N utility — not a custom CSS rule
No `!important` and no px value was added
The space between the neighbours equals the chosen token at 390 and 1440

evals.name: dark-variant
evals.expected_output: theme="dark" on the Section; no color overrides in component CSS.
assertions: The section uses theme="dark" (or the theme-dark class)
No component CSS branches on a theme class or sets palette colors directly
